```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)

# Load datasets and assign metadata
load_donor <- function(file_path, donor_id, sex, age_group) {
  counts <- Read10X_h5(file_path)
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = donor_id, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  obj$donor <- donor_id
  obj$sex <- sex
  obj$age_group <- age_group
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  return(obj)
}

d1 <- load_donor("data/donor1.h5", "Donor1", "Male", "18-35")
d2 <- load_donor("data/donor2.h5", "Donor2", "Male", "18-35")
d3 <- load_donor("data/donor3.h5", "Donor3", "Female", "36-50")
d4 <- load_donor("data/donor4.h5", "Donor4", "Female", "36-50")

pbmc <- merge(d1, y = c(d2, d3, d4), add.cell.ids = c("D1", "D2", "D3", "D4"))

# QC Filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 500 & nFeature_RNA < 4500 & percent.mt < 15)

# Normalization & Dimensionality Reduction
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, npcs = 30)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.4)

# Cell Type Annotation
cluster_ids <- c(
  "0" = "CD4 T Cells", "1" = "CD14+ Monocytes", "2" = "CD8 T Cells",
  "3" = "NK Cells", "4" = "B Cells", "5" = "CD14+ Monocytes",
  "6" = "FCGR3A+ Monocytes", "7" = "Dendritic Cells", "8" = "Platelets"
)
pbmc <- RenameIdents(pbmc, cluster_ids)
pbmc$cell_type <- Idents(pbmc)
```

# Quality Control

```{r qc-plot, fig.cap="Mitochondrial and gene count metrics per donor prior to cell filtering."}
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), group.by = "donor", ncol = 3)
```

```{r cluster-renaming}
# Rename unannotated clusters
pbmc_clean <- RenameIdents(pbmc,
  '9'  = "Plasmablasts",
  '11' = "gamma-delta T cells",
  '10' = "Doublets/Artifacts",
  '12' = "Doublets/Artifacts",
  '13' = "Platelet-T Doublets",
  '14' = "Platelet-T Doublets"
)

# Filter out identified doublets/artifacts
pbmc_clean <- subset(pbmc_clean, idents = c("Doublets/Artifacts", "Platelet-T Doublets"), invert = TRUE)
```

```{r umap-plot, fig.cap="UMAP projection of annotated PBMC populations."}
DimPlot(pbmc_clean, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")
```

# Downstream Analysis & Validation

```{r downstream-analysis, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# 1. Plot cell type proportions across donors
p1 <- ggplot(pbmc_clean@meta.data, aes(x = orig.ident, fill = Idents(pbmc_clean))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Proportion", x = "Donor", fill = "Cell Type", title = "Cell Composition") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 2. DotPlot of canonical markers across cell types
canonical_markers <- c("CD3D", "CD4", "CD8A", "TRDC", "NCAM1", "CD14", "FCGR3A", "MS4A1", "MZB1", "LYZ")
p2 <- DotPlot(pbmc_clean, features = canonical_markers) + 
  RotatedAxis() + 
  labs(title = "Lineage Marker Expression")

# Display plots side-by-side
p1 + p2
```
